text: In the 1890s, after two brigands [stumble across a Native American burial site|wrong|disturbing the dead], the town of Bright Hope wakes to find its jail empty and an arrow left behind. Sheriff Franklin Hunt rides out with his backup deputy Chicory, the gunslinger John Brooder and Arthur O'Dwyer, limping on an injured leg, to [rescue Arthur's wife Samantha|who_suffers|spouses and lovers]. Their trail leads to the valley of [a tribe of inbred cannibal troglodytes|threat|people who kill], who [signal with bone whistles set in their windpipes|rules|how it hunts].
